title: PHOIBLE 2.0

coverage.description: Curated phonological inventories with segment features, allophone, tone, source and marginality metadata.

limitations: An inventory is a source-specific doculect record; inventories must not be merged merely by ISO or Glottocode.
Coverage and analysis conventions vary by contributing source.
This manifest does not pin a local payload; a downloaded payload must add its SHA-256 before use in a release build.
